build.description: Compiles TypeScript and builds production assets for applications and packages

dev.description: Starts development servers for all packages in parallel with hot reloading

lint.description: Checks code style and catches common errors across all workspace packages

typecheck.description: Runs TypeScript type checking without emitting output files

test.description: Runs the Vitest test suite across all workspace packages

format.description: Formats source code across all workspace packages

format:check.description: Checks that source code is formatted without writing changes
